responsibility: This file provides the AArch64 target hooks used by C-family front ends. It defines and updates the target preprocessor builtins and ACLE feature macros according to the current backend state and options, handles target-pragma changes by reparsing and restoring AArch64 option state, reinitializes SIMD builtin availability under pragma target, registers the AArch64-specific #pragma GCC aarch64 handler, and dispatches overloaded builtin resolution and builtin-call checking between the general AArch64 and SVE builtin subsystems. Its role is therefore the language-facing bridge between the AArch64 backend’s option/features model and C-family parsing, macros, pragmas, and overloaded intrinsics.
